title: Site administration
forbiddenDescription: The current account is not an instance administrator.
contextErrorDescription: Check the connection and try again. Your access settings were not changed.
loadErrorDescription: Check the connection and try again.

registration.title: Self-registration
registration.description: Allow users to create accounts. Valid invitations still work when closed. Workspace access comes from invitations, administrators or the default access policy.
registration.noMethods: No registration method is available. Configure company sign-in or verification email delivery before opening registration.
registration.emailDescription: Sign in after verifying your email. Eligible users receive default Workspace access.
registration.developmentOutbox: Email delivery is in development mode. Verification messages are kept locally and are not sent.
registration.methodRequired: Select at least one registration method before saving.
registration.saveError: Could not save the registration policy. Refresh and try again.
registration.verificationScope: Applies to email registration, sign-in, and invitation acceptance.
registration.verificationRiskTitle: Email ownership will not be checked
registration.verificationRisk: Users can register with someone else’s email and may claim invitations for that address. Disable only when you trust registering users. Changes take effect when saved.
registration.deliveryRequired: Configure email delivery before enabling registration with verification.

pending.title: Accounts awaiting workspace access
pending.description: These accounts are verified. Assign a workspace and role before they can enter.
pending.emptyDescription: Verified accounts without workspace access will appear here.
pending.assignError: Could not grant access to {{name}}. Your selection is kept; try again.
pending.noWorkspace: There is no active workspace to assign. Create or restore one before granting access.

awaiting.title: No workspace yet
awaiting.description: Ask a workspace administrator to add your account, or open an invitation to join.
awaiting.signOutError: Could not sign out. Try again.

accounts.title: Site accounts
accounts.statusFailed: Could not update account status. Check administrator and workspace owner protections, then retry.
accounts.suspendConfirm: This account will lose access to every workspace.
accounts.membershipFailed: Could not update membership. Refresh and retry; every workspace must retain an active owner.
accounts.removeConfirm: Remove this account’s access to this workspace?
accounts.disabledDescription: Contact a site administrator to restore your account.

invites.title: Pending invitations
invites.failed: Could not process the invitation. Refresh and retry.
invites.revokeConfirm: This invitation link will no longer grant workspace access.
invites.share: Invitation created. Share the link privately with the recipient, who must verify this email or use a matching trusted identity to join.
invites.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select and copy the link manually.

defaultAccess.title: Default access for new users
defaultAccess.description: Eligible self-registered users join the selected Workspace once. Invited users receive invitation access only. Later removals and role changes are preserved.
defaultAccess.identityHint: One exact domain per line, without @ or wildcards. Either a trusted enterprise login source or a verified matching domain qualifies.
defaultAccess.registrationClosed: Self-registration is closed. Saving this policy does not open registration.
defaultAccess.loadError: Could not load default access settings. Retry.
defaultAccess.saveError: Could not save. Check domains, Workspace and identity conditions, or reload if the policy changed.
defaultAccess.preview: Preview existing users and allocation failures
defaultAccess.previewHint: Only eligible users who have never received Workspace access or been suspended are listed. Invitation-related accounts are excluded. Select up to 100 per batch.
defaultAccess.applyError: Assignment did not complete. Reload the preview and retry. Existing permissions are preserved.
defaultAccess.applied: Assigned {{granted}} users; {{other}} were not assigned because eligibility or destination availability changed.
defaultAccess.failureHint: Users can retry temporary failures on the waiting page. Restore an unavailable Workspace or assign access manually. Policy changes do not replace an existing registration's destination.
defaultAccess.awaiting_verification: Verify your email, then retry access allocation.
defaultAccess.workspace_unavailable: Your assigned Workspace is unavailable. Contact an administrator to restore it or assign another Workspace.
defaultAccess.temporary_failure: Access allocation did not complete. Retry, or contact an administrator if the problem persists.
defaultAccess.not_eligible: Automatic access conditions were not met. Contact an administrator.
defaultAccess.saveBeforePreview: Save the current policy before previewing existing users.
